newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ATHERTON PUTS AUSTRALIA IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ATHERTON PUTS AUSTRALIA IN TO BAT.

text.p: England captain Mike Atherton won the toss and put Australia in to bat in the first of three one-day internationals on Thursday.
The weather was cold and overcast.
England - Mike Atherton (captain), Nick Knight, Alec Stewart, Graham Thorpe, Graham Lloyd, Adam Hollioake, Mark Ealham, Phil DeFreitas, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Dean Headley.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Greg Blewett, Michael Slater, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Jason Gillepsie, Michael Kasprowicz, Glenn McGrath.
